title: Squash Cat
description: Adds my friend's cat named squash to the game.
body:
**requires [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) or [optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)**

---

**Rename an orange cat to Squash to change its appearence to Squash.**

---

![Squash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f379c6a0219780b9a8d1c15561fbddde55e8648.gif)

**Rename an orange cat to Squeal to change its appearence to Squash but with his actual face.**

---

![Squeal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d02194680c5ad7f11869bb55d59d26b9ac3f8ca4.gif)

**Texture contains built-in support for [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations).**

---
![Before Fresh Animations (left) vs After Fresh Animations (right)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b6b99e09e5eee01e3845ecf3a5575537752dcce.jpeg)

**Shaders used for photos is [Complementary Shaders Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)**

---
